result.title: EAGLE: Entropy-Aware Geometric Learning Enhancer for Partially Polygon-Supervised Object Localization
result.comment: 25 Pages, 3 figures, submitted to International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR) 2027
result.summary: Object detection is a critical application of computer vision, yet models trained uniformly on bounding boxes lack the geometric precision to be fully effective in inference settings, especially at high IoU thresholds. One common approach is the introduction of polygon-supervised localization, where a model is trained explicitly for localization but with access to polygon masks during training. Among such methods, partial polygon supervision is viable due to the higher annotation costs of developing fully supervised training datasets. However, this introduces a further challenge: in object classes of relatively low shape complexity, the addition of training masks and subsequent segmentation loss may obscure box localization, often worsening model performance despite access to deeper geometric information. To address the practical limitations of both full and partial polygon supervision, we introduce a mathematical framework for quantifying per-class geometric complexity by combining information theory and statistical shape analysis. With this framework, we develop Entropy-Aware Geometric Learning Enhancer (EAGLE), a lightweight, post-training model head that learns geometric information for the localization model, improving accuracy via edge refinement and localization rescoring using entropy-informed updates. Empirical analysis across MS COCO and Pascal SBD demonstrates the entropy framework meaningfully predicts shape reconstruction error and accuracy differences among mask-derived and standard box predictions, while the implemented EAGLE framework achieves consistent improvement on already SOTA detection frameworks (+0.9 mAP50-95 points on MS COCO) at minimal observed inference overhead.

AI.brief_summary: 论文针对部分多边形监督下的目标定位，提出以信息论结合统计形状分析量化各类别几何复杂度的框架，并据此设计轻量的后训练头部 EAGLE，通过边缘细化与熵驱动的重打分提升检测精度。
AI.relevance_reason: 其用熵刻画表示的几何信息丰富度并预测深监督是否有利，可能与 LVR 中「内部状态需保留多少几何细节才算够用」的度量问题相通，可供核查；但原文不涉及 latent 推理或多模态推理状态，迁移属推测。
